title: LeverScope model
description: A system dynamics (stock-and-flow) model that LeverScope (https://leverscope.com) opens and simulates in the browser. Open it with https://leverscope.com/app/#model=<base64url of the raw-DEFLATE-compressed JSON>, https://leverscope.com/app/#json=<URL-encoded JSON>, or paste it at https://leverscope.com/app/#paste. Positions are optional: LeverScope lays the map out. Files exported from LeverScope (format stockflow-1) are also accepted. Guide: https://leverscope.com/for-ai.html

format.description: Only in files exported from LeverScope; omit when writing a model by hand.

notes.description: What the model is about and what to try.

dt.description: Time step; at most a quarter of the shortest time constant in the model.

oneOf.title: Stock
oneOf.description: Something that accumulates. Changes only through flows.

name.description: Letters, digits and underscores (spaces are turned into underscores). Refer to it in equations with underscores. Not case-sensitive.

doc.description: What the element means, in one or two sentences.

eq.description: Starting value (a number or a formula of constants).

oneOf.title: Flow
oneOf.description: A rate per time unit that fills or drains stocks.

name.description: Letters, digits and underscores (spaces are turned into underscores). Refer to it in equations with underscores. Not case-sensitive.

doc.description: What the element means, in one or two sentences.

eq.description: Amount per time unit, e.g. Members/Average_Stay.

from.description: Name of the stock it drains, or null for outside the model.

to.description: Name of the stock it fills, or null for outside the model.

biflow.description: May flow both ways (negative values reverse it).

name.description: Letters, digits and underscores (spaces are turned into underscores). Refer to it in equations with underscores. Not case-sensitive.

doc.description: What the element means, in one or two sentences.

eq.description: A number or a formula, e.g. Potential_Members + Members or LOOKUP(Price, 20,1.2, 40,0.6).

kind.description: decision: something the user controls; assumption: something uncertain

slider.description: Show this converter as a slider. true chooses a range automatically. Only for converters whose eq is a plain number.

plots.description: Element names to chart first (default: the stocks).

$comment: Equation language: + - * / ^ ( ), comparisons = <> < > <= >=, AND OR NOT, IF c THEN a ELSE b, MIN, MAX, SMTH1/SMTH3(input, time), DELAY1/DELAY3(input, time), DELAY(input, time), LOOKUP(x, x1,y1, x2,y2, ...), STEP(height, time), RAMP(slope, time), PULSE(amount, first, interval), SAFEDIV(a, b), NORMAL(mean, sd), RANDOM(min, max), NOISE(mean, cv), SQRT, EXP, LN, LOG10, ABS, ROUND, INT, a MOD b, TIME, DT, STARTTIME, STOPTIME. Nothing in a model is executed as program code.
